decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 25/04/05 it could not be established that the limitation period for the taking of enforcement action had expired, therefore the use of the subject premises as outlined in the application is considered to be unlawful under Section 191 (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1995.
Condition : 2 - 
Informative:

If a further application is made more evidence must be submitted that shows the house has been in a continued use as two separate flats since May 2001, which would include the following:

?	Tenancy agreements since September 2001 for the first floor flat
?	Evidence that both flats have separate utilities for at least the last 4 years e.g. BT and Gas bills and evidence as to when these separate utilities were installed
?	A statement from the occupier of the ground floor flat setting out the history of the flats.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the retention of property as two self contained flats.
